item.dc:creator: Lauren Roberts

item.title: El Niño’s hidden toll on trees emerges years later in Papua New Guinea rainforest
item.description: When the El Niño drought ended in a remote Papua New Guinea rainforest, the trees did not immediately recover. Many kept dying. That is one of the findings of a recent study of more than 21,000 trees in the Wanang Forest Dynamics Plot, a 50-hectare (124-acre) research site in northern Papua New Guinea. Researchers measured […] Fuente: Mongabay.
item.dc:creator: Isabel Esterman

item.title: Live: Beau Lamarre-Condon says he was smitten, not obsessed with Jesse Baird
item.description: Beau Lamarre-Condon is back being cross-examined by the prosecution in his double murder trial. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Millie Roberts

item.title: Police hopeful of finding teen missing in dense bushland since Friday
item.description: William, whose surname has not been released by authorities, was camping with a friend at Walhalla East, near Cowwarr in Gippsland, when he disappeared on Friday. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Bec Symons

item.title: Live: Victorian Liberals to preference One Nation above Labor
item.description: Opposition Leader Jess Wilson says the Coalition will be mostly preferencing Labor and the Greens last on how-to-vote cards and "all other parties above that". Follow live in our election blog. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Defence site in Darwin's suburbs pitched as location of potential new hospital
item.description: The Northern Territory Labor Opposition says it will build a new Royal Darwin Hospital if it wins the 2028 NT election. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Matt Garrick

item.title: Animal welfare campaigner dobbed into council for having five rescue cats
item.description: Lisa Roberts-Daintree receives a compliance notice from Redland City Council after a neighbour reported her for exceeding Redland's two-cat maximum rule. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Kenji Sato

item.title: 81-year-old sci-fi writer becomes oldest winner of $95k Booker Prize
item.description: Octogenarian M John Harrison has won the Booker Prize for The End of Everything, which the judges described as "the politics of now seen through the lens of the future". Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Hannah Story

item.title: Acute mental health patients waiting up to six days in hospital's ED
item.description: One doctor described the situation as unprecedented, immoral and potentially dangerous. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Emily Baker

item.title: The elusive desert frogs scientists want Central Australians to find
item.description: Some desert frogs can spend years underground, emerging only after rain. Now scientists are asking Central Australians to help track them down. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Chris Murrkarany Fitzpatrick

item.title: Floreat killer was 'control freak' upset at losing 'trophy wife'
item.description: Double murderer Mark Bombara, who shot a mother and daughter as they pleaded for their lives in their Perth home, was a "domineering" man who could not cope with the end of his marriage, an inquest is told. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Lucy Murray

item.title: How China's hunger for green stones fuels Myanmar's civil war
item.description: The jade-smuggling trade is growing in Myanmar, exposing how the global hunger for precious minerals can finance and fuel conflict. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Libby Hogan

item.title: HungryPanda workers say 'punishment' for stolen food creating a safety risk
item.description: Delivery workers say they are being forced to pay for orders that are stolen from them, as attention turns to safety after the stabbing death of Feng Jianming in Melbourne. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Melissa Brown

item.title: Rent isn't always 'dead money'. Here's why
item.description: Owning your own home can give a welcome sense of security, but the jury is out on whether it's the best money move. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Lacey Filipich

item.title: Will you nail our Aussie inventions quiz or go back to the drawing board?
item.description: Humans are an inventive bunch, constantly coming up with solutions to problems and working out ways to make life easier or better. And many ingenious inventions are Australian. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Kylie Andrews

item.title: New documentary dissects an Australian tragedy from all sides
item.description: Blackfella Films producer Darren Dale's directorial debut, 2.6 Seconds: Death in The Outback, dissects the shooting death of 19-year-old Warlpiri man Kumanjayi Walker by Northern Territory police officer Zachary Rolfe. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Velvet Winter

item.title: Operator of Neil the seal merchandise website fined for false claims
item.description: The operator of a now-closed Neil the seal merchandise website has been fined for "falsely" claiming it was donating a portion of its profits to conservation organisations. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Meg Whitfield

item.title: Hobart's new lord mayor pledges to 'turn the ship around'
item.description: Hobart City Council's newly elected councillors have been formally sworn in. New Lord Mayor Charles Wooley says he wants to be a "people's mayor". Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Meg Whitfield

item.title: Russell Brand sentenced to more than 10 years in prison for rape and sexual assault
item.description: Judge tells disgraced actor and comedian he had displayed ‘casual, arrogant disregard of any woman’s right to say no’ Russell Brand sentencing – live updates Russell Brand was sentenced to more than 10 years in prison on Monday after a judge praised his victims’ bravery and accused him of living “unhindered by the rules by which decent people live”. As the judge, Mr Justice Bennathan, sentenced Brand for raping one woman and sexually assaulting three others, he said he had told the trial “a series of lies”. item.title: Queensland security guard who fought for Russia missing, feared dead
item.description: Daryl "Dundee" Fladung was recruited to fight for Russia while playing video games at home in outback Queensland. Ten days after posting about joining the frontline, he went missing. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Grace Tobin and Kate McKenna

item.title: ASIC launches investigation into collapsed Bathla Group
item.description: Corporate regulator ASIC launches a formal investigation into collapsed property giant Bathla Group, which owes creditors at least $3.4 billion. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
